title: Jury still out...
text: I received my first box and in it was a spruce that was a tiny little thing with 3 leaves. The other seemed like a proper size, we shall see how they do. I definitely liked the presentation and the information on their care, helpful and well done. Going to leave the "overall rating" and "value for money" at 3 stars for awhile to see how they do and what the next box brings.
label: neutral
